how.title: Up and running in four steps

accounts.title: Your school sets up accounts
accounts.description: Administrators add classes, teachers and students, or import them from a spreadsheet.

signIn.title: Everyone signs in securely
signIn.description: Each person has their own account, and everyone confirms with a code from Microsoft Authenticator.

learn.title: Teach and learn
learn.description: Teachers assign homework and tests; students learn with their tutor, games and challenges.

insights.title: Follow progress
insights.description: Teachers and leaders see how learning is going and step in early.

languages.title: Speaks your school's languages
languages.description: Arabic with full right-to-left support, plus English, Chinese, German, Spanish and French. Everyone chooses their own language, and it follows them to every device.

accounts.question: How do I get an account?
accounts.answer: Your school creates it. Administrators add students and teachers or import them from a spreadsheet, and each person receives their own sign-in. There's no public sign-up.

password.question: I forgot my password. What now?
password.answer: Ask your school's administration. They can give you a temporary password, and you'll choose a new one the next time you sign in.

security.question: How is our data protected?
security.answer: Each school sees only its own data. Passwords are stored as one-way hashes, every account — students, teachers and staff — uses two-step verification, sensitive actions ask for a fresh code from the authenticator app, and Cloudflare's bot check keeps automated sign-in attempts out.

ai.question: What does the AI tutor do?
ai.answer: It explains lessons step by step in the student's language, at the level and in the style they choose in their settings. Teachers stay in charge of homework and tests.

devices.question: Does it work on phones?
devices.answer: Yes. {brand} runs in any modern browser on phones, tablets and computers, with nothing to install.

languages.question: Which languages are available?
languages.answer: Arabic, English, Chinese, German, Spanish and French. Each person picks their own language, and can change it at any time.
